quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Advances U.S. Manufacturing Investment (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BMS selected Generation Park in Houston, Texas, for a new modular, multi-modal manufacturing campus, an approximately $2.3 billion investment of about 600,000 square feet for small molecules, biologics and antibody-drug conjugates (drug product and finished goods from late development through launch), expected to employ nearly 500 people initially and to create approximately 2,000 construction and other indirect jobs between 2027-2030 as it is built and brought online. It is part of BMS's $40 billion commitment to invest in the U.S. over five years across R&D, technology and domestic manufacturing; BMS invested approximately $10 billion in R&D in 2025 and already works with a contract manufacturer in Texas for commercial and clinical-trial manufacturing. CEO Christopher Boerner: the company is building the domestic manufacturing capabilities needed to deliver the next generation of medicines.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $2.3 billion campus; nearly 500 jobs; part of $40 billion U.S. commitment over five years
